{{Top}}
'''Hologames''' were electronic games. [[Galactic Rebels]] was a hologame that allowed players to take on the personae of the heroes of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] in defeating [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces. The young [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Lumpawaroo/Legends|Lumpawarrump]] often played as his [[Parent/Legends|father]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]].
